question.text: Accumulated losses (other than business loss) at investment fund level as on March 31, 2019:

answer.text: Are deemed as losses in the hands of unit holders on March 31, 2019 (carryforward for 8 years)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.1, Section 115UB sub-section (2) amendment: accumulated non-business losses as on March 31, 2019 deemed as losses of unit holders on that date; 8-year carry-forward allowed. The Trap: Other treatments don't apply under the Finance Act 2019. Cross-Exam Context: One-time carry-forward permission for unit holders. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Ensure unit holders claimed March 2019 losses in their 2019-20 returns.
